fusions.name: Swarming Coal
fusions.desc: Hurls a cinder that deals 12 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Chaff Whirl
fusions.desc: Whirls burning chaff around you that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Ravening Cloud
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a burning swarm for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second, with a 30% chance to set it [Burning] for 3 seconds. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Stripped Fields
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
